newsitem.title: EGYPT: Hoechst unit in Egyptian gas joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst unit in Egyptian gas joint venture.

text.p: Egypt's partly private Alexandria National Iron and Steel (ANSDK) and German firm Messer Griesheim are to set up a $25 million joint venture firm to produce industrial gases in Alexandria, Egypt.

Jannik Lindbaek, executive vice president of the International Finance Corporation (IFC) which is facilitating the deal, told a news conference on Wednesday he would witness the signing of the joint venture agreement on Thursday.
The firm will be called Messer Gases Dikheila and will target the Alexandria market, he added.
Messer Griesheim is a subsidiary of Germany's Hoechst AG. The Egyptian state is a majority shareholder in ANSDK.
